name: io.github.Glob0x17/mcp-icloud-caldav
title: iCloud Calendar (CalDAV)
description: iCloud Calendar over CalDAV: list, create, update, move and delete events. Optional read-only mode.

environmentVariables.name: ICLOUD_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: App-specific password from appleid.apple.com (not the Apple ID password)

environmentVariables.name: MCP_ICAL_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to leave out the create, update and delete tools

environmentVariables.name: MCP_ICAL_LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: Log level on stderr: TRACE, DEBUG, INFO, WARNING or ERROR
